# SPDX schema fixtures

Unmodified upstream SPDX 2.3 JSON schema retrieved on 2026-10-29 from:

- https://github.com/spdx/spdx-spec/blob/v2.3/schemas/spdx-schema.json

The SPDX specification (including this schema) is licensed under Creative Commons
Attribution 3.0 Unported; see the upstream
[LICENSE](https://github.com/spdx/spdx-spec/blob/v2.3/LICENSE).
The schema is included so enrichment validation remains offline.

The SPDX 3.0.1 JSON schema is also available offline in
`spdx-3.0.1-json-schema.json`. Its authoritative source is the
[SPDX 3.0.1 JSON schema](https://spdx.org/schema/3.0.1/spdx-json-schema.json).

Copyright © 2010–2024 The Linux Foundation and its Contributors. The upstream
[SPDX 3.0.1 copyright notice](https://spdx.github.io/spdx-spec/v3.0.1/front/copyright/)
identifies the Community Specification License 1.0 and the license for
pre-existing portions. Git normalizes this copy's line endings to LF.
